response.original_title: After Dive - Una vita in sincro
response.overview: After Dive tells a story of passion, perseverance, discipline, and companionship. The athletic preparation required in springboard diving demands constant training, a ritual that perfects technique, coordination, and concentration. The film unfolds at the Karl Dibiasi pool in Bolzano, where Tania Cagnotto and Francesca Dallapè, Europe’s most successful synchronized diving pair, have trained since 2008. Two years after initially saying farewell to the boards, they return to train together for the next Olympic Games. In the meantime, both have become mothers: Tania to Maya and Francesca to Ludovica.
